messages:
alex: FYI: planning a quiet-window push for py & ts SDKs in ~15m. Goal: flip dist-tag shadowing, validate wheels, and publish release notes. please standby for deploy-bot output.
maria: ack. which dist-tags are we changing?
alex: we'll move 'latest' -> 'canary' for a brief shadow, then 'stable' -> 'latest' if checks pass. keep old tags in place as 'previous'.
sam: quick checklist: 1) sign checks on wheels 2) smoke install 3) QA smoke on node client 4) update release notes link 5) set deprecation blurb for sync client.
li: I noticed a signer mismatch earlier on the nightdrop for py wheels. are we re-signing or yanking?
alex: aim to avoid yanking if possible. flow: verify signature, if mismatch then yank the bad wheel and republish signed artifact with same version+build id. fallback is pin 'latest' back to previous.
deploy-bot: publish job started: job_id=6149, phase=uploading artifacts, target=py/ts, user=alex
maria: running local smoke: pip install --index-url https://pypi.internal/simple redwood-sdk==2.1.0rc3 --no-deps
maria: install succeeded, import test passed: from redwood import Client; print(Client().version) -> 2.1.0rc3
sam: node smoke: npm i @redwood/sdk@2.1.0-rc.3 && node -e "const {Client} = require('@redwood/sdk'); console.log(new Client().version)" -> prints 2.1.0-rc.3
li: deploy-bot shows one wheel with signing warning in artifact registry: file redwood_sdk-2.1.0rc3-py3-none-any.whl, checksum mismatch with signature.
alex: OK halt the tag flip. @deploy-bot please stop promotion to 'stable' until we confirm.
deploy-bot: promotion paused by alex. job_id=6149 state=paused
jordan: i'll regenerate signature and push signed wheel to staging. ETA ~12m. will update once done.
maria: updating release notes to call out minor API tweak and deprecation note for sync client planned for 3.0. draft link: https://go/release/6150 (do not publish yet)
sam: if jordan can't re-sign in time we'll proceed with pin strategy: publish signed artifact under +rev (2.1.0rc3+1) and set 'latest' to previous stable, then schedule a follow-up republish.
jordan: uploaded signed wheel 10m ago to staging, running validation: signature OK, pip install & import smoke pass.
deploy-bot: resumed promotion: job_id=6149 state=resumed, promoting artifacts to pypi/stable and npm/registry 
alex: once deploy-bot confirms success, I'll flip dist-tags per the plan and post final release notes + deprecation snippet. If anything fails, rollback plan: 1) unset new 'latest', set 'latest' -> 'previous' 2) yank bad artifact, 3) announce in #general + support.
maria: noted. I'll prepare the release note PR and the deprecation paragraph for the changelog.
sam: reminder: update SDK changelog entry with migration steps for users using sync API -> async rewrite. small code snippet in notes helps.
li: monitoring publish logs, no 500s from registry. all artifacts show green.
deploy-bot: job_id=6149 complete. status=success. tags updated: 'previous' retained, 'latest' -> 2.1.0rc3+1, 'stable' -> 2.1.0rc3+1
alex: awesome, thanks everyone. i'll push release notes now and send the deprecation email draft. follow-up: schedule a canary rollback window tomorrow 09:00 UTC for any late regressions.
maria: done: release notes PR opened https://go/release/6150/pr ready for review.
sam: leaving a postmortem checklist in the PR: include who signed the wheel, time of republish, and reason for the mismatch.
li: will add the registry audit log snippet.
jordan: thanks all — will be on-call for the morning rollback window.
alex: closing thread. :tada:
